stem: Pentagon MNPQR is shown on the coordinate grid. Pentagon MNPQR is dilated with the origin as the center of dilation using the rule \((x,y) \to \left(\frac{1}{4}x, \frac{1}{4}y\right)\) to create pentagon M'N'P'Q'R'.

options.label: F
options.text: Pentagon M'N'P'Q'R' is larger than pentagon MNPQR, because the scale factor is greater than 1.

options.label: G
options.text: Pentagon M'N'P'Q'R' is smaller than pentagon MNPQR, because the scale factor is less than 1.

options.label: H
options.text: Pentagon M'N'P'Q'R' is smaller than pentagon MNPQR, because the scale factor is greater than 1.

options.label: J
options.text: Pentagon M'N'P'Q'R' is larger than pentagon MNPQR, because the scale factor is less than 1.

visual_elements: Coordinate grid with pentagon MNPQR plotted with points approximately at M(-8,-7), N(-7,-3), P(-5,5), Q(-3,8), and R(11,2).
